security_questions: What is the patient's ID number?
What is the patient's date of birth?
What was the date of service?
authentication.notes: Green Shield Canada (GSC) also administers claims for RBC Insurance under carrier ID 000124 on the same providerConnect infrastructure. When calling about a Green Shield plan, their own CDAnet carrier code is 000060. Make sure you are calling the right line — the GSC provider line (1-888-711-1119) handles GSC plans only, not RBC Insurance plans.

steps.expected_prompt: Thank you for calling Green Shield Canada. For English, press 1. Pour le français, faites le 2.
For dental and health providers, press 1. For plan members, press 2. For plan administrators, press 3.
For claim inquiries, press 1. For eligibility and coverage verification, press 2. For predetermination status, press 3. To speak with a representative, press 0.
Please enter the plan member's identification number.
Please hold for the next available representative.
steps.notes: Average hold 15-20 minutes. GSC tends to have shorter hold times than Sun Life or CDCP.

shortcuts.destination: May skip to representative queue on voice-recognition prompts

common_denial_reasons.resolution: Check GSC benefit schedule for the specific plan. Plan designs vary widely — some exclude implants, orthodontics, or cosmetic procedures.
GSC plans have annual maximums that vary by employer. Patient is responsible for overage — bill patient directly.
Common: 2 recall exams/year, bitewings 1/year, polishing 2/year. Confirm specific plan limits with rep.
Major restorative work over certain threshold requires pre-auth. Submit via providerConnect.ca portal or CDAnet.
Submit X-rays or periodontal charting through providerConnect.ca portal — fastest method. Fax is also accepted.
Claim already processed. Ask rep for the original payment date and amount to verify receipt.
Submit to primary plan first. Attach EOB when submitting to GSC as secondary.

common_denial_reasons.description: Patient not enrolled or coverage lapsed
common_denial_reasons.resolution: Verify employment status and coverage dates. Patient may have had a qualifying life event that changed coverage.

required_attachments: X-rays for crowns, bridges, root canals
Clinical photos for esthetic or complex cases
EOB from primary carrier for COB claims

key_phrases: I'm calling from [Practice Name] regarding a Green Shield Canada dental claim
The CDAnet carrier ID is 000060 and the patient's ID number is [ID]
Can you confirm the current adjudication status of this claim?
What is the specific denial reason code and is an appeal possible?
Can documentation be uploaded through the providerConnect portal?
What is the expected payment date if the claim is approved?
avoid_phrases: RBC Insurance — GSC administers RBC plans but they are separate; use the RBC line for RBC plans
Green Shield is slow — GSC actually has faster processing than most carriers
Why was this denied without telling us — ask for specific denial code instead
escalation_triggers: Claim not found despite valid member ID and date of service — may be routing issue with RBC plans
Rep confirms payment issued but not received after 30+ days
Claim flagged for clinical review with no clear timeline provided
Denial reason appears inconsistent with plan documents on file
COB issue where GSC and another carrier are both rejecting as secondary payer
ai_agent_guidance.representative_script_hints: GSC reps are generally efficient and knowledgeable. Their providerConnect.ca portal is one of the better ones in the industry — many issues can be resolved via portal before calling. If a rep asks you to upload documents, they can usually process within 3-5 business days. GSC has some of the shorter hold times among major Canadian dental carriers.

metadata.notes: Green Shield Canada is a non-profit health and dental benefits carrier — one of the few in Canada. They also run the providerConnect.ca portal infrastructure used by RBC Insurance. GSC has a reputation for faster adjudication than most competitors. Common among tech and public sector employer plans in Ontario. Important: do not confuse GSC plans (carrier 000060) with RBC Insurance plans (carrier 000124) — they share infrastructure but are billed separately.
